exchanges: boxes everywhere. the move to eastmere is coming up fast and ive packed basically nothing
Packing always takes longer than expected, but you'll get there.
my husband anselm keeps labelling boxes 'misc' which is useless
Ha, the classic mystery box approach.
the kid is thrilled about having a bigger room
That's sweet, a new room is a big deal for a kid.
work was fine, mapped a coastline all day. being a cartographer is weirdly calming
That does sound like satisfying, focused work.
our neighbour hester came by to say bye with her dog gravy, i nearly cried
Goodbyes to good neighbours are hard.
hes a vizsla so he basically vibrates with energy
That breed is known for being a bundle of energy!
need to cancel the internet here, the hold music is torture
Hold music really tests anyone's patience.
our daughter marisela asked if the new house has a ghost lol
Kids ask the best questions, hope you reassured her!
my brother dashiell is helping us move the heavy stuff saturday
That's a big help, moving furniture is no joke.
he lives over in fennick so its a bit of a drive for him
Really kind of him to make the trip.
dashiell just started at quillon too so hes a bit stressed
A new job on top of helping you is a lot, good of him.
ugh found my old school yearbooks while packing
Those always pull you straight back in time.
made me nostalgic for wickhollow, i grew up there and never went back
Old yearbooks will do that, it's a strong pull.
my niece rowan is home from uni, shes studying linguistics now
Sounds like she's found something she loves.
she went to larkspur academy before that, same as dashiell actually
Nice that there's a family connection there.
lunch today was crackers and cheese standing in a kitchen full of boxes
Moving-week meals are always a bit improvised.
my husband wants to sell his citroen before the move, i say keep it
Hard to know whether a car is worth taking along.
funny thing, my mate rowan went back to school too, doing horticulture
Never too late to go back, good for them!
feeling a bit overwhelmed tbh
That's completely understandable with so much going on.
going to order pizza, no way im cooking tonight
Pizza sounds like exactly the right call.
hester said shell visit once were settled
That's lovely, it'll be nice to stay in touch.
packed the whole bookshelf tonight, small win
Small wins add up, nice work!
the kid wants to bring every single stuffed animal
Honestly, that seems like a fair request for a big move.
dashiell's girlfriend is coming saturday too, apparently shes a sommelier
Sounds like she might bring good taste to the moving crew!

questions.message: remind me which town we're relocating to
